You will be responsible for the assembly and mounting of products.You will be trained as a multi-skilled worker and deployed across 8 different workstations.

You are able to work in a two-shift system and can work both independently and as part of a team.You already have some initial experience in assembly work.You are punctual and work accurately.You speak English or Dutch so that you can communicate with colleagues.

•

• 
Here you follow a pick order to pack and sort the goods according to destination.

 
•

•

•

•

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!
 

A selection of your responsibilities:
 

 
• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
 
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
 
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
 
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
 
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
 
• You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
 
• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
 
• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools. 

We are looking for the following profile:
 

 
• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
 
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
 
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
 
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
 
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
 
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
 
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
 
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
 
• You are available for a full-time position.

Your tasks?

• Maintenance of electrical and mechanical systems.
• Troubleshooting and repairing machine malfunctions.

Who are you?

For our client, a company in the Ghent region that operates in the steel industry, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Overhead Crane Operator.

Your tasks: 

• You will be responsible for lifting and moving steel plates using the overhead crane.
• You will work independently.
• You must not be afraid of heights and must have good depth perception.
• You have to load the trucks with metal parts.
• Correctly positioning the metal coils in the warehouse. 

Who are you?
• You speak English well
• You live within a 30-km radius of Evergem and have your own transport. 
• You enjoy working independently and do so effectively, are not afraid of heights, and have good depth perception.
• You are a hard worker.
• Experience as a crane operator.

Accounting Officer - The Role

• Book invoices in the accounting software (AP/AR/bank statements)
• Create and transmit invoices to customers, liaise with the credit control department
• Prepare month-and year-end closings (salaries, provisions, accruals..)
• Prepare regular reports for the company's finance department at HQ
• Point of contact for the external accountant & during audits
• Day-to-day administration & office management
 
 
Accounting Officer - About You

• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or in a relevant field
• You have at least 5 years' experience in a similar position in a Belgian company
• You are fluent in English, Dutch and/or French are an asset
• You thrive working autonomously
 
 
Accounting Officer - The Offer

The company offers a competitive salary package including:

• Gross salary between 4000€ & 5000€ based on your experience
• Meal vouchers
• Hospitalization Insurance for you and your family
• Performance bonus
You will join a newly launched department with a steady growth curve, being part of a small team within a global organization in which you will have a key role managing administration and accounting.

Responsibilities

• Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and clarify complex business requirements.
• Translate business needs into conceptual models such as use case diagrams, activity diagrams, and information models.
• Refine requirements into user stories and collaborate with developers to ensure successful sprint delivery.
• Execute functional tests and support users during acceptance testing while conducting product demonstrations and training.
• Manage service requests and production issues to suggest continuous improvements for the product suite.
• Engage actively in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in functional and business analysis within Agile methodologies such as Scrum, SAFe, or LeSS.
• You bring proficiency in modeling with UML and BPMN.
• You possess experience using modeling and documentation tools like Sparx Enterprise Architect and Confluence.
• You have knowledge of relational databases and the ability to write SQL queries.
• You're experienced with backlog and sprint management tools like Azure DevOps or Jira.
• You possess a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on simplifying complex challenges.
• You're proactive and collaborative with excellent stakeholder management skills.
• You are fluent in English with a good command of either French or Dutch, with a willingness to improve proficiency in French or Dutch

Responsibilities

• Define and oversee cloud migration strategies for critical production workloads.
• Lead modernization programs covering transition, cutover, and decommissioning phases.
• Design scalable and secure cloud architectures based on organizational requirements.
• Provision and configure production cloud environments using automation tools.
• Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements

• You bring 10+ years of experience in cloud architecture roles within complex environments.
• You possess 15+ years of overall professional experience in the IT sector.
• You have documented experience as an architect on Azure migration and modernization programs.
• You bring hands-on experience using Terraform and Ansible for infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
• You're a Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
• You possess a valid certification issued by OVHcloud or Scaleway.
• You are fluent in English with at least a B1 level in Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Willingness to adapt architectural designs to evolving European hyperscaler standards.

Lead the technical evolution of a modern cloud platform, combining .NET development, software architecture, AI-assisted engineering, and technical leadership.

Our partner is a technology-driven organization investing heavily in cloud-native development, AI-assisted software engineering, and modern platform architecture.

As part of a growing engineering team, they are looking for a Senior Developer / Tech Lead who can combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities.

This role goes far beyond pure development. You'll influence architectural decisions, mentor developers, drive engineering excellence, and help shape the future of an AI-native software delivery environment where AI agents actively support coding, testing, and refactoring activities.
Senior Tech Lead | The Role
• Design, build, and enhance scalable applications using .NET, C# and Microsoft Azure.
• Transform business requirements into robust technical solutions, architectures, and implementation plans.
• Establish and promote high engineering standards through code reviews, mentoring, and technical coaching.
• Work alongside AI-powered development tools to accelerate delivery while ensuring the quality, security, and maintainability of the resulting software.
• Drive architectural decisions and contribute to the evolution of cloud-native and event-driven systems.
• Identify opportunities to improve development practices, platform performance, delivery processes, and technical solutions.
Senior Tech Lead | The Profile
• You bring extensive experience in .NET / C# software development, ideally within complex enterprise environments.
• You have strong expertise with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based architectures.
• You are comfortable working with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• You have experience with Angular or modern front-end development frameworks.
• You regularly leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions and understand both their strengths and limitations.
• You have a proven ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, challenge architectural decisions, and drive software quality across a development team.
• Complete proficiency in Dutch, English and French
 

Nice to Have

• Experience with Event-Driven Architecture, messaging systems, and asynchronous integrations.
• Exposure to GraphQL, PostgreSQL, or document-oriented data management.
• Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and scalable software design practices.
• Experience with event sourcing patterns and distributed applications.
• Familiarity with modern search and analytics technologies.
• Microsoft Azure or DevOps certifications are considered a plus.

• Manage, maintain and optimize the IT infrastructure.  
• Administer Windows 11, Windows Server, Hyper-V, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.  
• Manage and maintain network infrastructure (HP/Aruba).  
• Deploy and configure PCs using SCCM.  
• Provide technical support to end users and resolve hardware, software and network issues.  
• Troubleshoot and resolve IT incidents and system failures.  
• Improve IT security and manage access rights, security updates and patches.  
• Participate in IT infrastructure, networking and security projects.  
• Implement new technologies and continuously improve existing IT systems.  
• Maintain technical documentation and IT procedures.  
• Monitor system performance, availability and reliability.  
• Collaborate with IT colleagues on larger IT projects and support each other whenever needed.  
• Keep up to date with the latest IT technologies, infrastructure developments and cybersecurity best practices. 
  
• Associate degree in ICT (Graduate).  
• At least 1 year of experience in ICT.  
• Knowledge of Office 365, networking infrastructure, back-up solutions, software and hardware environment.  
• Good command of English, French and Dutch.  
• Soft skills:     
• Excellent planning and organizational skills.   
• Good oral and written communication.   
• Good resistance to stress.   
• Good listening skills.   
• Interest in new technologies.   
• Ability to communicate efficiently.      
• Experience from an international work environment is an asset.

Your responsibilities as a Customer Service Officer :

Customers :* Handle requests and claims from customers by phone and by email;* Contracts & files : check input, rebates & additional services contracts;* Follow-up marketing actions decided by the Benelux Country Manager;* Order of new customer cards and toll box;* Follow-up portfolio of customers;* Help train the customers to use autonomously extranet, customer portal etc.

General administration :* Mails (post) and the e-mails on the general mailbox;* Sales support for the sales representatives : invoice, edit credit notes, etc;* Reporting activities;* Back-up of colleagues (customer service, sales officer).

Network :* Administrative help to Technical Manager;* Manual acceptance authorization;* Follow up of fraud cases in stations;* Resolve and help customers on issues related to cards and tolls.

The ideal profile of a Customer Service Officer :* You have a perfect command of Dutch, both spoken and written. You also have a very good knowledge of French, both spoken and written. Knowledge of English is an asset.* You have initial experience in Customer Service, Customer Care or file management.* You have a good knowledge of IT tools (MS Office) and are familiar with CRM systems.* You are an organised person, you are willing to take initiative and you have good customer relations skills.* You can easily switch between different tasks and have strong communication skills.

Support to “Quality Manager-Europe” in daily business:

 

• Coordinate the development of monthly and weekly Quality report
• Support meeting preparation and presentation development
• Follow up on Logistics
• Liaise with the regional Project & Sales Team in Brussels
• Coordination with Bosch Residents and with the Quality representatives from all Bosch Business Units delivering one of major automobile manufacturer
• New Projects Monitoring & Review follow-up
• Field Parts recovery and follow-up
• Daily Part Recovery observation

You are currently an engineering or international management student with very good computer skills (MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint).

Basic knowledge in SAP R/3 is appreciated. You have very good analytical and communication skills and the ability to work independently, using own initiation as well as a pro-active approach to the issues.

 

You are fluent in English.

• Portfolio Development & Business Growth     
• Develop and expand the company's product portfolio within specialty chemicals.   
• Identify new products, suppliers and market opportunities based on customer needs and market developments.   
• Build business cases for new product groups and assess their commercial potential.   
• Leverage your existing industry network to establish new supplier relationships and unlock additional business opportunities.   
• Proactively identify opportunities to expand the company's market presence and generate additional revenue.      
• Strategic Procurement & Supplier Management     
• Develop and execute procurement strategies aligned with the company's growth ambitions.   
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with international suppliers.   
• Lead commercial negotiations on pricing, payment terms, delivery conditions and contractual agreements.   
• Monitor global raw material markets, pricing trends and supply risks.   
• Identify alternative suppliers and products to improve competitiveness and supply reliability.      
• Commercial & Financial Management     
• Work closely with Sales to identify customer needs and translate these into portfolio opportunities.   
• Monitor purchasing costs and market developments and translate these into competitive selling prices.   
• Set and review monthly sales price levels for different products.   
• Identify opportunities to improve gross margins and overall profitability.   
• Contribute to the development of new business through strong supplier and market relationships.      
• Operational & Supply Chain Management     
• Oversee purchasing activities and ensure timely replenishment of inventory.   
• Balance stock availability, customer service levels and working capital.   
• Monitor supplier lead times and delivery performance.   
• Support demand forecasting and inventory optimization.   
• Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes and reporting.     
  
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Chemistry or equivalent experience.  
• 5–10 years of experience in procurement, sourcing or portfolio management.  
• Strong experience in the chemical industry and an established network of contacts within this industry, with the ability to leverage these relationships to create new business opportunities.  
• Proven experience in international supplier management and commercial negotiations.  
• Strong strategic, commercial and analytical skills, with a good understanding of pricing, margins and inventory management.  
• Hands-on, entrepreneurial and proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently.  
• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French are a plus.
